### Reading John’s Prophecy
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/reading-johns-prophecy
Passage: Revelation 1:3
Points:
- Revelation pulls back the veil to show God’s sovereign work operating behind earthly events.
- God promises a distinctive blessing to those who not only read this prophecy but heed and obey it.
- John writes within biblical prophetic tradition, applying God's truth to sustain believers facing trials and persecution.
- A faithful understanding of Revelation requires deeply engaging the Old Testament foundations woven throughout the book.

### Are You Ready for the Lord?
Author: Michelle S. Lazurek
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/are-you-ready-for-the-lord-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Revelation 1:3
Points:
- God sees all of our deeds, thoughts, and motives, leaving nothing truly hidden from His sight.
- The prophecy of Revelation is intended to prepare believers for Christ's return rather than cause dread.
- When Jesus returns, believers will be held accountable for how they lived out their faith.
- Taking this book to heart means examining our daily conduct and repenting of lingering sin.
